title: CodeDataSource
description:
Code-based data source for executing custom .NET provider logic to fetch or transform data.
Implements IParametrizedDataSource<CodeDataSourceParameter>.
Enables integration with registered service providers that implement custom business logic,
data transformation, or integration with third-party systems not directly accessible via API or database.
Parameters are passed to the code provider for custom processing.

name.description: Gets the unique name identifier for this code data source. Used in component bindings.

type.description: Gets the data source type. Always DataSourceType.Code.

singleResult.description:
Gets or sets whether this code provider returns a single result object rather than a collection.
When true, array results are unwrapped to a single object.

allowUnauthorizedAccess.description:
Gets or sets whether this code provider allows unauthenticated execution.
When true, the provider executes without requiring authentication context.

codeProviderName.description:
The class that serves this data source, as "AssemblyName,Namespace.TypeName".
CodeSourceService splits it on the comma, loads the assembly, finds the type (case-sensitive)
and creates it with ActivatorUtilities — so constructor injection works. The class must
implement ICodeDataSourceProvider. It is NOT a DI registration name.
Example: "MyApp,MyApp.Catalogue.CatalogueLookupSource".

forwardPaginationParameters.description:
Gets or sets whether pagination parameters (page, pageSize, skip, take) should be forwarded to the code provider.
When true, component pagination settings are passed as provider parameters.

parameters.description:
Gets or sets the list of parameters to be passed to the code provider for custom processing.
Parameters support token substitution for component state, user claims, and pagination info.

DataSourceType.description:
Specifies the type of data source, determining how data is fetched and processed.
JSON serialized as string values. Used to classify data sources and route to appropriate executors.

allOf.description:
Defines a code provider parameter for custom business logic data sources.
Extends DataSourceParameterBase with an IsRequired flag to control whether the parameter must be provided.

isRequired.description:
Gets or sets whether this parameter is required by the code provider.
When true, the parameter value must be provided or provider execution may fail.
When false, the provider can proceed without this parameter if not available in component state.

DataSourceParameterBase.description:
Base class for all data source parameter definitions.
Parameters define how external values (component state, user claims, pagination info) map to data source inputs.
Supports token substitution: ${componentName}, ${item.field}, ${User.attribute}, ~UserID, ~NOW.

sourceName.description:
Gets or sets the source location of the parameter value. Required.
Examples: component name, nested path (item.field), claim name.
Supports token syntax like "${itemValue}", "${User.Id}", "~UserID", "~NOW".

destinationName.description:
Gets or sets the destination name for this parameter in the data source.
For API parameters: the OpenAPI parameter name.
For SQL parameters: the SQL parameter name (with or without @ prefix).
For Table parameters: the filter/search/query field name.
If not specified, defaults to the SourceName.
